passage: Most museums display objects from many different periods, places, and cultures. Unlike them, the small Harlow Museum's entire collection focuses on a single ______ the history of flight.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: The part before the blank is a complete sentence; "the history of flight" explains what the theme is.
A colon introduces an explanation after a complete sentence.
A semicolon needs a complete sentence after it; no punctuation runs the ideas together; "which" creates an ungrammatical clause.
key: Use a colon after a complete sentence to introduce what it points to.
